observations.inspection: Layered translucent document panels and converging cyan paths; a conceptual knowledge/evidence visual with no hardware claim.
Dark conference table with silver recorder, headphones and open notebook; room setting distinct from all other covers.
Finned metal edge computer with exposed ports on optical inspection bench; industrial laboratory subject distinct from prototype board.
Hands inspect black unbranded glasses beside a green field notebook on stone; tactile human scale and warm neutral materials.
Overhead circuit board, leads and metal caliper on orange bench mat; different angle, composition and palette from edge computer.
Warm procurement desk with open sample packaging, requirement sheets, pen and material swatches; commercial brief concept rather than knowledge stack.

observations.design: Same palette alone is not used as evidence of duplication. Visual inspection of all six 640 px derivatives confirms different subjects and compositions; original-file hashes establish distinct binaries but are not the sole basis for that conclusion.

observations.semantics: Solutions and reference cases use unique explanatory SVG diagrams. Resource cards use unique document icon geometry and localized cover titles. Their counts should not be presented to the user as newly generated photographs.

observations.social: All 18 article pages use the registry cover for OpenGraph and BlogPosting JSON-LD. twitter:card is summary_large_image; there is no separate twitter:image override, so there is no competing stale Twitter-specific image assignment.
